question.text: PEG ratio = P/E ÷ Growth rate. A PEG of 1.0 suggests:

explanation.text: The Logic: Peter Lynch rule: PEG = 1.0 = fair; < 1 cheap; > 1 expensive (relative to growth). The Trap: Rule of thumb, not precise. Cross-Exam Context: XV Ch 10. Manager's Pro-Tip: PEG works best in growth industries; mature industries with low growth have high PEGs intrinsically.
